calls.body: The Blue Jackets’ penalty kill is around the middle of the league, and the Devils’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Blue Jackets tonight.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Gritsyuk wins it in a shootout
paras: Nico Hischier struck first for the Devils midway through the first. The Blue Jackets’ Denton Mateychuk left in the first period and didn’t return. The next day, he was ruled out with a concussion. Cole Sillinger tied it up for Columbus midway through the second. Evan Rodrigues restored the Devils’ lead on the power play with 37 seconds left in the period. Luca Del Bel Belluz made it 2-2 for Columbus midway through the third. Arseny Gritsyuk scored the only goal of the shootout for the Devils. The Jackets’ Sean Monahan was back in the lineup after missing five games, and picked up an assist.
The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Connor Hellebuyck made 22 saves for the Devils, and Cam Talbot stopped 24 of 26 at the other end.

Brenden Dillon was thrown out with a match penalty midway through the first. The Devils killed all four Blue Jackets power plays. The Devils improved to 17-8-0, second in the Metropolitan, while the Blue Jackets fell to 9-13-1, seventh in the Metropolitan.

items.text: Jesper Bratt passed Scott Niedermayer for second on the Devils’ all-time assists list, with 365.
